scope: Current H69-J publication evidence; older archived claims remain archived, not newly certified. The 2026-10-20 lane-69 joint-corridor artifact (39,958 dots) failed the literal registry dot-overlap gate (0.8285 > 0.70) and is likewise quarantined; no download, no slot. The 2026-10-20 H69-EFG artifact (29,027 dots) cleared all scientific, holdout (+53.9%, p=1.0000), canary, and validator checks but failed literal Rule 1 3-px forward registry overlap (> 0.70) and remains quarantined. The 2026-10-20 H69_G5_TwoRegimeGeodesic artifact (32,000 dots, SHA-256 28375c97...) cleared all scientific, whole-segment pooled holdout (0.081323 vs 0.031868 control, 2.55x), canary, sparse/dotlike (0.6365 <= 0.70), local-prior (0.1566 <= 0.70), and validator checks, and remains quarantined pending human selector resolution of universal prior IR-69-REG-01.
resolution_rule: Cannot clear by copying an old measurement or changing a raster hash. Literal stop must first be resolved without an unauthorized density exemption, then real independent measurement and provenance review are required.

findings.finding: The legacy generator synthesized missing single-feature AUCs, reused an earlier holdout, and hard-coded validator success after subprocess failures. The current archived numbers are not thereby proven fabricated, but their measured provenance cannot be certified.
findings.source: scripts/generate_unique_submission.py at base commit 04b46c116677fc76965b06c32acb148cc9078a1a, lines 93-150 and 175-190
findings.disposition: Unsafe generator retired; original bytes/evidence preserved for forensic audit. No fabricated replacement measurements.

findings.finding: Archived surface and dot summaries both use the TIFF file SHA as the decoded-array SHA, assert unique=true, but their literal_reading duplicate flag is true with overlap 1.0. Summary pass flags are not valid literal clearance.
findings.disposition: Release gate checks literal numeric evidence and contradictory phase flags; negative.

findings.finding: The previous release policy allowed a dotlike stratum pass to override failed literal overlap. Existing regression omitted the numeric dotlike row and therefore missed the bypass.
findings.source: scripts/release_gate.py at base commit 04b46c1, lines 35-52; tests/test_release_gate.py
findings.disposition: Removed bypass; added realistic regression and numeric cross-checks.

findings.finding: The archived joint arm mean is below the earlier corridor mean; current_best_beaten treats overlapping uncertainty as a win. This is not positive evidence of improvement over the current best. Mean-of-cells is also not pooled TP/FP/FN.
findings.disposition: Require measured pooled statistics and positive spatial-block paired confidence intervals, not pass flags.

findings.finding: Lane holdout call sites derive a >2px flank exclusion from the full catalogue, including hidden targets, instead of the visible catalogue. This violates the requested visible-only derivation even if it conservatively depresses recovery. In addition, the older leakage_canary computes corridor propensity from ctx.grid.catalogue (the full catalogue), not each cell's visible subset; an AUC below 0.90 does not exonerate that direct violation.
findings.disposition: No current holdout certified. No silent post-stop scientific fix or rerun; visible-only mask repair must precede a new preregistered experiment.

findings.finding: Production H69-J uses raster-skeleton tips and subparallel strike/overlap proxies, not same-dip, measured-slip source-polyline pairs. Downloadable mirror qfault_attributes.csv does contain DIPDIRECT and SLIPSENSE: the problem is unintegrated/authentication-limited attributes, not that no attributes exist anywhere.
findings.disposition: Record official GDR v2 and USGS Siler metadata; require provenance-preserving visible-segment attribute joins.

findings.finding: The implementation uses a Gaussian difference divided by a horizontal gradient and takes abs(sin(tilt)). Gaussian smoothing is not upward continuation, and this unsigned proxy does not test signed tilt-zero crossings or opposing transverse edge phase. Lithologic contacts can produce both gravity and magnetic gradients.
findings.disposition: Correct active site descriptions; retain model source unchanged after the duplicate stop.

findings.finding: The rejected user file and portal internals are unavailable. Out-of-range values and sentinels are local failure conditions; attributing the actual rejection to NaN or promising that zeros prevents rejection is unsupported.
findings.source: User prompt; scripts/validate_submission.py; official problem page 967
findings.disposition: Format checks labelled local/mirror-based, never organizer acceptance.

findings.finding: The archived run_lane69/relayfix/transfer callers use shared build_holdout, which chunks branches at MAX_SEG_PX=12 and withholds without a feature-context collar. Quadrant-boundary erosion does not implement whole-fault-segment hiding with a buffer.
findings.disposition: Retain main's hash-bound whole-segment protocol gate and imported transfer-runner guards. No private evaluator fork; a future authorized runner must use the existing shared buffered instrument. No rerun after the stop.
